text: Persistent flags are stored in each command's `PersistentFlags` set (`command.go:1725-1735`). For a child, `mergePersistentFlags` calls `updateParentsPflags`, then adds both its own persistent set and the accumulated parent persistent set to `Flags()` (`command.go:1847-1855`). A named lookup similarly falls back through `persistentFlag`, which updates and searches `parentsPflags` (`command.go:1805-1816`).
